element_name: Structure and shell (walls floors foundations roof doors windows stairs)
authority: CAA 2001 Part 2A s.270AA; s.270CA residential-use test; s.270CF personal-care exception; CA92800; 3 per cent
notes: Barred where the building is used, or expected to be used, as a dwelling (s.270CA) UNLESS it falls within the s.270CF exception for a building providing residential accommodation together with personal care (E-10). Care Homes, rooms in a care setting: test s.270CF on the facts before assuming a bar - a genuine registered care home providing personal care is the paradigm case the exception is aimed at (contested, CTA sign-off required). Care Homes, self-contained extra-care/sheltered flats: s.270CF does NOT rescue this - CA92800 additionally bars self-contained flats from SBA regardless of on-site personal care (E-13). Supported Living: s.270CF does not generally apply - residents hold their own tenancies and support is a separate service, not personal care integrated into the accommodation, so the residential bar usually stands. Construction contracts on or after 29 Oct 2018. s.270BI excludes anything qualifying as plant. Reduces CGT base cost

element_name: Heating, hot-water and ventilation systems/plant
authority: CAA 2001 s.33A(5)(c); s.35 dwelling restriction; CA23060
notes: E-7 / E-2 fix: tested INDEPENDENTLY of LS-SL-001 and independently of room location. If this plant serves the dwellings (a shared/central boiler, heat pump or district system), it is EXCLUDED IN FULL wherever it is sited (CA23060) - regardless of the room being a common part. Only heating/hot-water/ventilation plant that serves solely the common parts is apportionable under this row. A boiler serving the dwellings and corridor lighting (LS-SL-001) can sit in the same plant room and carry opposite answers.
